We love to receive contributions from the community so please keep them coming :) 

Pull requests, issues and commentary welcome!

Please complete the relevant template for issues and PRs. Sometimes it's worth getting in touch with us to discuss changes 
before doing any work incase this is something we are already doing or it might not make sense. We can also give
advice on the easiest way to do things :)

Before opening your first pull request or issue, please read the Development Process (https://ocelot.readthedocs.io/en/latest/building/devprocess.html). Maintainers may ask first-time contributors to complete identity verification based on a public LinkedIn profile linked to their GitHub profile. Ocelot does not accept pull requests from automated agents. See the Identity-verification procedure for first-time contributors (https://github.com/ThreeMammals/Ocelot/discussions/2441) for details.

Finally we mark all existing issues as help wanted, small, medium and large effort. If you want to contribute for the first time I suggest looking at a help wanted & small effort issue :)
